summary_zh: 本页为绘本《红细胞旅行记》的封面，展示了书名、作者、插画师、出版社及系列名称，画面中有两个拟人化的红细胞角色。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
在人的体内，住着一群热爱旅行的细胞小人，他们每时每刻都在身体中旅行。他们有的叫红细胞，有的叫白细胞，还有的叫血小板。
虽然大家的旅行目的不同，但都共同维护着人体系统的正常活动。
page_text_en:
Inside the human body, there live a group of tiny cell travelers who are always on the move. Some are called red blood cells, some are white blood cells, and others are platelets.
Although their travel purposes differ, they all work together to maintain the normal functioning of the human body.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了人体内三种主要的细胞——红细胞、白细胞和血小板，它们像旅行者一样在身体中活动，共同维护人体系统的正常运作。画面展示了三个拟人化的细胞在血管中快乐奔跑的场景。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
红细胞小人每次旅行都会带上氧气，她喜欢把氧气放到沿途的各个角落，再带回二氧化碳作为旅游纪念品。
红细胞小人背上氧气时，整个身体会变得红红的，
但当她放下氧气，背上二氧化碳后，身体就会变成暗紫色。
page_text_en:
The red blood cell little person always carries oxygen on every trip. She likes to deliver oxygen to various corners along the way and then bring back carbon dioxide as a souvenir of her journey.
When the red blood cell little person carries oxygen, her whole body turns bright red.
But when she releases the oxygen and carries carbon dioxide, her body turns dark purple.
summary_zh: 本页通过放大镜视角展示了一个拟人化的红细胞在血管中旅行的场景，并解释了红细胞携带氧气和二氧化碳时身体颜色的变化。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
每次出发前，红细胞小人会先到肺部登记，领取旅行
所需要的氧气，然后统一集中在心脏候车室准备出发。
“嘿！伙计，又要出发去旅行了吗？”其他细胞小人
一看到她们都会这样和她们打招呼。
候车室
page_text_en:
Before each departure, red blood cell little people first register at the lungs to collect the oxygen needed for their journey, then gather together in the heart's waiting room to prepare for departure.
"Hey! Buddy, are you going on another trip?" Other cell little people would greet them like this whenever they saw them.
Waiting Room
summary_zh: 本页描绘了红细胞小人在肺部领取氧气后，前往心脏候车室集结准备出发的场景，其他细胞小人向她们打招呼，画面展现了心脏作为‘候车室’的拟人化设计。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
哇！
呀哈！
耶！
这天，一队红细胞小人从心脏候车室浩浩荡荡出发了。她们就像高速公路上的汽车那样，前进得非常快。
她们从不担心会塞车，因为所走的路线全部是单行道；她们也从不担心会迷路，因为各种大大小小的血管遍布全身，无论去到哪里，最终都会回到出发地——心脏。
心跳会议室
page_text_en:
Wow!
Yay!
Yay!
Today, a group of red blood cell little people set off in a grand procession from the heart's waiting room. They move forward as fast as cars on a highway.
They never worry about traffic jams, because their route is always a one-way street; they also never worry about getting lost, because blood vessels of all sizes spread throughout the body, and no matter where they go, they will eventually return to their starting point—the heart.
Heartbeat Meeting Room
summary_zh: 红细胞小人从心脏出发，在血管中快速前进，画面展示了她们在血管中欢快奔跑的场景，并解释了血管如同单行道、最终都会回到心脏的循环原理。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
不管是宽阔的动脉大血管马路，还是窄窄的毛细血管马路，红细胞小人都能顺利穿过。
虽然有些马路特别窄，但红细胞小人也一样能飞快地驶过。有时在路上还会遇上马路破损，只要情况不是特别严重，她们就能迅速通过。
page_text_en:
Whether it's the wide arterial highways or the narrow capillary roads, red blood cell little people can pass through smoothly.
Although some roads are especially narrow, red blood cell little people can still zoom through quickly. Sometimes they encounter damaged roads, but as long as the situation isn't too serious, they can pass through swiftly.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了红细胞小人在不同粗细的血管中穿行的场景，强调它们能顺利通过宽阔的动脉和狭窄的毛细血管，即使遇到血管破损也能快速通过。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
可是，这次红细胞小人在旅途中遇到了一件非常糟糕的事情——身体受伤了！她们要穿过的血管马路破损得很严重，不少红细胞小人从马路断裂处掉了出去。
更可怕的是，一群细菌坏蛋趁机入侵了，他们在马路上横冲直撞，还想杀死红细胞小人！
救命啊
救命
page_text_en:
However, this time the red blood cell little people encountered a terrible problem on their journey—the body was injured! The blood vessel road they were supposed to pass through was severely damaged, and many red blood cell little people fell out from the broken parts.
Even worse, a group of bacterial villains took the chance to invade. They were running wild on the road, trying to kill the red blood cell little people!
Help!
Help!
summary_zh: 红细胞小人在血管中旅行时遭遇身体受伤，血管破损导致部分红细胞掉落，同时细菌趁机入侵并攻击红细胞，红细胞发出求救声。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
红细胞小人们虽然被吓得全身发抖，但她们迅速冷静了下来，启动危机处理方案。
有的小人打了110报警电话：“血管马路被破坏，有坏蛋趁机入侵，请白细胞小人立刻赶来救援！”
有的小人打了120急救电话：“手臂受伤，红细胞小人死伤严重，请血小板小人立刻赶来救援！”
还有的小人组织大家有序撤离，避免从马路断裂处掉出去，同时还要躲避细菌坏蛋的袭击。
page_text_en:
The red blood cell little people, though shaken and trembling, quickly calmed down and activated their crisis response plan.
Some of them called 110, the emergency number: "The blood vessel road is broken, and bad guys are invading. Please send the white blood cell little people to rescue us immediately!"
Others called 120, the medical emergency number: "The arm is injured, and many red blood cell little people are seriously hurt. Please send the platelet little people to rescue us immediately!"
Still others organized an orderly evacuation to avoid falling out of the broken road, while also dodging attacks from the bacterial bad guys.
summary_zh: 红细胞小人们在血管破损、细菌入侵的紧急情况下，迅速冷静并启动危机处理方案，分别拨打110和120求助白细胞和血小板，并组织有序撤离。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，伴随着一阵“嘀嘟嘀嘟”的警报声，正在附近巡逻的白细胞小人们赶到了：“别害怕！这些坏蛋交给我们吧！”
瞧！他们勇敢地向细菌坏蛋飞奔过去，把细菌坏蛋包围住，迅速把他们消灭掉了！
红细胞小人激动地大叫起来：“白细胞小人加油！加油啊！”
加油！
加油啊！
page_text_en:
At this moment, with a 'beep beep' alarm sound, the white blood cell little people who were patrolling nearby arrived: "Don't be afraid! Leave these bad guys to us!"
Look! They bravely rushed toward the bacteria villains, surrounded them, and quickly eliminated them!
The red blood cell little people excitedly shouted: "White blood cell little people, come on! Come on!"
Come on!
Come on!
summary_zh: 白细胞小人赶到现场，勇敢地包围并消灭了入侵的细菌，红细胞小人则在一旁为他们加油助威。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
此时，一群血小板小人也赶到了现场，他们紧紧地团结在一起，并勇敢地冲向马路断裂处，努力想把马路断裂堵住。
但裂缝太大了，许多血小板小人也从马路断裂处掉出去了，这可怎么办呀？
page_text_en:
At this moment, a group of platelet little people also arrived at the scene. They gathered tightly together and bravely rushed toward the broken road, trying hard to block the crack.
But the crack was too big, and many platelet little people fell out of the broken road too. What should we do now?
summary_zh: 血小板小人赶到血管破损处，试图用身体堵住裂缝，但由于裂缝太大，许多血小板也掉了出去，场面陷入困境。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
“我们一起来帮忙吧！”血小板小人和红细胞小人们手拉手，簇拥在一起，再沿着血管壁一点点地靠过去……伤口终于被堵住了！
“太棒啦！成功了！”所有的细胞小人一齐欢呼了起来！
page_text_en:
"Let's all help out!" The platelet little people and red blood cell little people held hands, gathered together, and slowly moved along the blood vessel wall... The wound was finally blocked!
"Great! We did it!" All the cell little people cheered together!
summary_zh: 血小板和红细胞手拉手，沿着血管壁合力堵住伤口，最终成功止血，所有细胞小人欢呼庆祝。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
这次的事故造成了许多细胞小人光荣牺牲：他们有的是被细菌坏蛋杀死了，有的是为了堵住马路断裂而掉下去了……他们都是最勇敢的细胞小人！
虽然有些细胞小人牺牲了，但是其他的细胞小人还会继续履行各自的职责，让身体系统正常运行。
page_text_en:
This accident caused many cell little people to make the ultimate sacrifice: some were killed by the bad bacteria, and others fell while trying to block the broken road... They were all the bravest cell little people!
Although some cell little people sacrificed themselves, the others will continue to fulfill their duties to keep the body system running normally.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了红细胞小人因事故牺牲后，其他细胞继续履行职责，并举行表彰大会纪念英勇牺牲的细胞小人。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
“不要难过，骨头有造血功能，以后会有越来越多的伙伴加入我们的队伍！”幸存的红细胞小人们相互安慰着，“我们一定要加油！身体需要我们每一个人！”
所有的细胞小人依然充满信心，任何困难都无法阻挡他们前进的脚步。
page_text_en:
"Don't be sad, bones have the function of blood production, and in the future, more and more companions will join our team!" The surviving red blood cell little people comforted each other, "We must keep going! Our body needs each and every one of us!"
All the cell little people remained full of confidence; no difficulty could stop their forward steps.
summary_zh: 幸存的红细胞小人相互安慰，强调骨头的造血功能和团队的重要性，所有细胞小人重拾信心，继续前进。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
1周
3周
1个月
血管的伤口会慢慢愈合，有的伤口会
留下疤痕，而有的伤口却不会留下疤痕，
但最重要的是要注意伤口不要感染，避免发炎。
虽然在旅行中可能会遇到各种危险，但是红细胞小人从
来不害怕。
看！红细胞小人们又出发了！
page_text_en:
1 week
3 weeks
1 month
The wound in the blood vessel will heal slowly. Some wounds will leave scars, while others will not.
But the most important thing is to make sure the wound does not get infected and avoid inflammation.
Although they may encounter various dangers during their journey, red blood cell little people are never afraid.
Look! The red blood cell little people are setting off again!
summary_zh: 本页通过三张照片展示伤口在1周、3周和1个月后的愈合过程，强调伤口愈合需避免感染，并说明红细胞小人不惧危险，继续踏上旅程。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
在回家的路上，红细胞小人带着二氧化碳，身体已变成了暗紫色。她们知道，一旦回到了心脏室，再把二氧化碳交到肺部，她们就又会变成平时的鲜红样子了。
如果她们在路上碰到了一氧化碳，绝对会远远地跑开，因为那样很容易引起人体一氧化碳中毒呢！
page_text_en:
On the way home, the red blood cell little people carry carbon dioxide, and their bodies have turned dark purple. They know that once they return to the heart chamber and deliver the carbon dioxide to the lungs, they will turn back to their usual bright red color.
If they encounter carbon monoxide along the way, they will definitely run away quickly, because that can easily cause carbon monoxide poisoning in the human body!
summary_zh: 本页描绘了红细胞小人在完成运输二氧化碳任务后，身体变为暗紫色，准备返回心脏和肺部进行气体交换，并强调了它们会避开一氧化碳以防止中毒。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
对了，红细胞小人还知道一个血液秘密：
人类血型分为 A 型、B 型、AB 型和 O 型四种。在人体需要输血的时候，必须要输入对应型号的血液，不然就会发生危险的输血事故。
每一种血型系统都是由遗传因子决定的。人类的血型是经过长时间进化而形成的，也许以后还会出现更多的血型呢！
page_text_en:
By the way, the red blood cell little person knows a blood secret:
Human blood types are divided into A, B, AB, and O types. When the body needs a blood transfusion, it must receive blood of the corresponding type, or else a dangerous transfusion accident will occur.
Each blood type system is determined by genetic factors. Human blood types have evolved over a long period of time, and perhaps more blood types will appear in the future!
summary_zh: 本页通过红细胞小人的讲解，介绍了人类四种主要血型（A、B、AB、O）及其在输血中的重要性，并说明血型由遗传因子决定，是长期进化的结果。

title_en: The Journey of Red Blood Cells
page_text_ocr_zh:
听，前面有小孩的哭声传来，原来是膝盖摔伤了。
没关系，全体细胞小人出动，加油！
page_text_en:
Listen, the crying of a child comes from ahead — it turns out their knee is scraped.
Don't worry, all the cell little people, mobilize! Let's go!
summary_zh: 画面左侧一群红细胞小人惊慌地发现前方有小孩膝盖摔伤，右侧画面显示小孩哭泣，文字说明细胞小人准备出动救援。
